items.title: I tried those free AI-coded Adobe Creative Cloud clones, and they have some big problems
items.excerpt: A hands-on test of ArtCraft, the viral AI-coded open-source suite that clones Photoshop, Premiere and other Creative Cloud apps. The verdict: it isn't ready to replace Adobe's tools yet.

items.title: Impeccable vs Taste Skill: which Claude design skill to use, tested
items.excerpt: Two Claude front-end design skills, Impeccable and Taste Skill, run on the same real brief and compared on the pages they built, cost, speed, invented facts and rule-following, with a recommendation on which to pick.

items.title: Is your website AI slop? How to tell, and how to fix it
items.excerpt: A guide to spotting the tell-tale signs of generic AI-generated website design and copy, and practical fixes to restore a distinct visual and verbal identity.

items.title: Google will let you distribute vibe-coded Android apps with just a Google account
items.excerpt: Google is revamping the Play Store for the AI era, letting people publish Android apps they vibe-coded in AI Studio using only a Google account, alongside changes to publishing and recommendations.

items.title: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash now available on AI Gateway
items.excerpt: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6 and the faster Flash variant can now generate and edit images through Vercel AI Gateway, with one API key, unified billing and request traces.

items.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
items.excerpt: Higgsfield says GPT-6 Astra lets its creative agents keep consistency across videos longer than 10 minutes and call 3D-modeling tools, while GPT-Image-2.5 reliably renders text and infographics; its ~200 creatives prototype product ideas with Codex.

items.title: DLSS 5 gets toned down for its Hogwarts Legacy debut next month
items.excerpt: After backlash over how its neural rendering altered game art, Nvidia's DLSS 5 arrives in Hogwarts Legacy with a toned-down look, as Nvidia stresses developers keep 'detailed artistic control' and ships a 2x faster model.

items.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
items.excerpt: Ahead of the Oct. 16 RTX Spark laptop launch, Nvidia and Adobe rearchitect Photoshop and Premiere for up to 2x performance, RTX Video upscaling lands in ComfyUI, and Blender 5.3 gets DLSS Ray Reconstruction for real-time viewport previews.

items.title: Nvidia launches USD BRep geometry kernel for solid modelling
items.excerpt: Nvidia has launched a USD BRep geometry kernel for NURBS-based boundary-representation solid modelling, aiming to bring CAD geometry into OpenUSD and make greater use of AI in engineering design.

items.title: This game was made with AI in 30 minutes, and it's a bit of a wake-up call
items.excerpt: Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii built a playable game with AI in about 30 minutes, an experiment that makes game development look ridiculously easy and raises questions for game artists and designers.

items.title: Epic shifts to 'AI-accelerated development' for upcoming Disney game
items.excerpt: Epic Games is going all-in on AI, moving its upcoming Disney game to 'AI-accelerated development' that leans on AI for code and art production.

items.title: Now AI isn't just faking art, it's faking artists' signatures as well
items.excerpt: ChatGPT has been signing its fake New Yorker-style cartoons with real cartoonists' names, adding forged signatures to the attribution and copyright worries around AI image generation.

items.title: AI is hollowing out the middle of design, leaving an hourglass behind
items.excerpt: Anamol Rajbhandari argues AI is automating the middle of the design process, leaving work concentrated at the strategic top and the craft-and-judgment bottom, and reshaping what designer roles look like.

items.title: The synth everyone owned and few could program: a lesson for AI design
items.excerpt: Using the Yamaha DX7 and its presets as a parallel, Mathieu Poli argues AI made quality available to everyone and made it average; what sets design work apart now is a visible decision.

items.title: How to Hide a Cut in an AI Videos
items.excerpt: Three editing techniques for making AI-generated scenes flow together: match the action, use a foreground wipe, and let sound lead the next shot.

items.title: How I Make Motion Graphics Inside Claude Motion (Opus 5.5)
items.excerpt: A walkthrough pushing Claude Motion plus Higgsfield through three challenges: an editable launch video, a 3D product ad, and a complete animated short, with prompts and skills shared.
